title: Diphthongs and R vowels
summary: Let vowels glide, then hold an American R.

sentences: I can hear the rain now.
Her bird flew over the chair.
My voice moves through the vowel in day.
Turn right at the next road.

selfCheck: My vowel moved in day and now.
I kept my tongue shaped for the R in bird.
I did not cut the vowel glide short.
